name: natural-calendar
title: Natural Calendar
description: Create Apple Calendar events from natural language, e.g. "Lunch with Sam tomorrow at 1pm".
author: faridabbas

commands.name: create-event
commands.title: Create Calendar Event
commands.subtitle: Natural Calendar
commands.description: Type an event in plain English and add it to Apple Calendar.

commands.name: quick-add-event
commands.title: Quick Add Calendar Event
commands.subtitle: Natural Calendar
commands.description: Add an event from a single argument, no UI.

preferences.name: defaultCalendar
preferences.title: Default Calendar
preferences.description: Name of the calendar new events are added to. Must match a calendar in Calendar.app exactly.

preferences.name: defaultDuration
preferences.title: Default Duration (minutes)
preferences.description: Event length when no end time is given.

preferences.name: defaultTime
preferences.title: Default Start Time (HH:MM, 24h)
preferences.description: Start time used when the text has a date but no time.
